summary: Fixed a live reopen-after-broker-stop race in S007: decide() could still want a label the broker had already stopped out (its own M1-bar plan lagged the real tick-based fill by one cycle) and would attempt to re-place it with a now-invalid stop, saved only by luck when the broker rejected the order (TRADING_BAD_STOPS). Added StrategyLogger.label_was_opened() and made decide() backfill the close (reason=broker_side_close_detected) the same cycle it notices a previously-opened label missing from broker positions, instead of waiting for the next cycle to notice. Added regression tests covering both the new label_was_opened() method and the end-to-end decide() path.

Surfaced S007 "ghost" trades: plan_now() now returns reached_tp/n_recovery in context and a new resolved list of positions the engine entered AND resolved (stop/tp/daycap) within the same replayed bars -- these never reach the broker because decide() only places orders for still-open ('eod') positions, so previously they left no trace at all. decide() now logs each first-seen resolved position via a new StrategyLogger.label_was_ghosted()-guarded position(label, "ghost", ...) call. Investigated live 2026-08-05: a B setup formed and resolved before any cycle saw it as open; a historical replay of the events log (2026-08-01 through 2026-08-05) found 2 prior days (08-01, 08-03) with the same pattern -- a scenario detected, n_desired never above 0, no order ever placed -- newly distinguishable from a normal no-signal day now that this is logged.

Fixed StrategyLogger text-handler pinning (root cause of the ALGODEV-24 prod-log pollution): logging.getLogger() caches by name process-wide and __init__ only added handlers `if not handlers`, so the FIRST log_root a strategy name was constructed with owned the text stream forever. In a full pytest run, collection-time import of scripts/s009_tick.py (module-level StrategyLogger('S009') with the real root) made every isolated run_once() test leak fake cycles (BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT, for_date=2024-10-05) into the LIVE reports/logs/S009/S009.log (observed 2026-08-08..28). __init__ now rebinds handlers when the existing RotatingFileHandler's file differs from the expected <log_root>/<strategy>/<strategy>.log; JSONL streams were never affected (per-instance paths). Regression test added; leak reproduced on pre-fix code (prod log sha256 changed) and gone after the fix (42 utils/bot/scripts tests green, prod log byte-identical; the lines my repro run appended were removed, hash-verified). Incident write-up posted as ALGODEV-24 comment. NOTE: strategy-logging skill now slightly out of date (handler rebind semantics) -- update proposed to Anton, awaiting consent per code-architecture governance.

Day-scoped S007 risk caps after the 2026-09-02 incident (8 positions / ~-$401 / ~4% on a 2% cap day): both day caps in bot/s007_paper.py::decide were computed from the broker's open-positions snapshot, so every stop-out wave zeroed its own spent risk and the next wave got a fresh budget. Fix: (1) count cap now runs against opened_today_count -- every label our own append-only position log opened today (new StrategyLogger.open_records(prefix) in utils/trade_logger.py), union the live snapshot; (2) the $ gate now checks spent_risk_today = open_risk (broker fill/stop, unchanged) + closed-today risk at ACTUAL fill price, matched by position_id (now logged on the open record, extracted from ORDER_ACCEPTED) to the broker's last-24h closing deals -- run_live_cycle (bot/ctrader_s007.py) fetches _deal_list_step once per cycle in the same session and passes closed_deals into decide() (kwarg, default None -- old callers/fakes unaffected); planned-entry fallback when no deal matches, deal fetch failure falls back to [] and never kills the cycle. Slippage-inflated fills therefore keep counting at real size after closing. state/skip events now log spent_risk_today/closed_risk_today/opened_today. Replay of 2026-09-02's 8 opens vs the new gates: blocked from position 4 (10:57), day capped at ~-$194 spent of a $204 cap instead of -$401. Tests: 2 new in tests/bot/test_s007_live_sizing.py (stop-out waves; slipped fills from deal history incl. no-deals fallback); tests/bot/test_check_response.py SDK stub taught ProtoOADealListReq/ProtoOADealStatus (pre-existing breakage from the earlier deal-history import). Full run: 178 passed (tests/bot+utils+scripts+webapp).

Added a shared Redis to the compose stack, reachable from every job-run worker container. docker-compose.yml: new redis service (redis:7.4.1-alpine, --appendonly yes --appendfsync everysec --maxmemory 512mb --maxmemory-policy noeviction, named volume redis-data, healthcheck redis-cli ping); new top-level network algo with an explicit name: algo (NOT project-prefixed) so the Ofelia job-run label can attach ephemeral worker containers -- which are created straight through the podman socket, not as compose services -- to it by literal name; added ofelia.job-run.dispatch.network: algo and REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379 to the job-run environment array; worker (build-only) service also put on algo for documentation. Redis is deliberately NOT published to the host (Anton chose internal-network-only, no auth): only compose containers reach it, a host process (the manually-run webapp) cannot -- utils/redis_client.is_available() returns False there. One instance serves two roles: STATE_DB=0 for durable shared state / distributed locks / pub-sub, CACHE_DB=1 for the market-data cache still parked in docs/DEV_PLANS.md (cache keys carry their own TTL; server is noeviction). New utils/redis_client.py: redis_url() (REDIS_URL env, else DEFAULT_REDIS_URL redis://redis:6379), lru_cached get_client(db, *, decode_responses) with 2s connect/op timeouts, never-raises is_available(); guards a missing redis package (in requirements-docker.txt, added redis==5.2.1; also requirements.txt redis>=5.2,<6). 4 tests in tests/utils/test_redis_client.py (URL resolution, is_available False+no-raise without a server). DEV_PLANS.md updated: replaced the deferred market-data-cache bullet with Shared-Redis + cache-infra-ready + scheduler-lock-migration-candidate bullets. NOT done: wiring get_m1 read-through, migrating scripts/scheduler_tick.py data/.scheduler_locks to a Redis lock. Worker image (algo-worker:latest) must be rebuilt to pick up the redis dependency. Not run live (podman machine not reachable from this session); compose YAML + label JSON arrays validated, full tests/utils green (18 passed).
